name: Aiman
description: Veteran soldier on Farid's side who talked with Laria.

timeline.summary: Aiman, a wounded Fallaji soldier pierced by three arrows, lies among the dead of Kroog crying for water.
timeline.quote: Three arrows. He'd been hit.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: At night Aiman sees a glowing blue ghost he takes for Death, which says it is too early and that it does not happen here, then vanishes.
timeline.quote: We're too early,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Two weeks later Aiman's fever breaks; he has lost an eye but survives.
timeline.quote: He had lost an eye

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Human replacements, including Assad, Aiman and Ehsan, arrive and are assigned to Farid's section.
timeline.quote: These are yours, spearman.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Aiman introduces himself as a veteran who lost his eye at the Siege of Kroog.
timeline.quote: I lost my eye at the Siege of Kroog,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Officers distribute polish, silk and extra rations, signaling an attack, while Assad urges the others to cover themselves in glory.
timeline.quote: Our qadir means to set us on the attack again.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Farid, Karrak and Aiman plan a covert patrol that night and choose Ehsan as the fourth.
timeline.quote: The attack is certainly coming by the end of the week.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Farid gets an order chit and satchels from Sergeant Usman, who demands a full satchel in return, and leads the patrol over the top.
timeline.quote: One full satchel,

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The four shelter in a downed thopter in no-man's-land and hang a white cloth flag.
timeline.quote: Farid, quickly, hung the strip of cloth on the outside of the crashed thopter

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Four Argivians led by Laria arrive, and the two groups share spirits and goods, Aiman and Laria speaking Argivian.
timeline.quote: Four Argivians clambered into the wreck of the bomber.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Farid betrays the Fallaji attack plan, telling Laria about the transmogrants, replacements and extra rations.
timeline.quote: Our generals have moved in a whole regiment of transmogrants

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Laria tells Aiman that Tawnos has brought a dozen units of Clay Soldiers, so the Argivians know the attack is coming.
timeline.quote: Laria said they know our attack is coming.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The four agree to keep their secret, and the order to attack comes two days later.
timeline.quote: The order to attack came two days later.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: After a bombardment, the Fallaji wave charges across no-man's-land with transmogrants and finds the Argivian trench empty.
timeline.quote: They reached the Argivian trench and found it empty.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Karrak finds a packet containing chocolate and a note of gratitude from the Argivians, and the front moves on.
timeline.quote: revealing a small piece of chocolate and a note.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 4: The Ink of Empires" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Aiman was severely injured at the Fall of Kroog and lost an eye.
timeline.quote: Aiman was severely injured in the aftermath of the Fall of Kroog

citation.work: Aiman
citation.text: "Aiman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aiman was recalled to active duty for the Tomakul Campaign to train new warriors.
timeline.quote: Aiman was recalled to active duty for the Tomakul Campaign in 44 AR, this time to train new warriors

citation.work: Aiman
citation.text: "Aiman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aiman and his comrades kept secret intelligence that clay statues and transmogrants could fight the battle to avoid being branded traitors.
timeline.quote: They decided to keep this information secret to avoid being branded as traitors.

citation.work: Aiman
citation.text: "Aiman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Fallaji soldiers found the Argivian trench abandoned, and Farid found Laria's gift.
timeline.quote: they found it abandoned, its soldiers having fled the front

citation.work: Aiman
citation.text: "Aiman", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ehsan is chosen as a fourth member for a covert patrol to trade with the enemy.
timeline.quote: He was selected by Farid , Karrak , and Aiman for a covert operation

citation.work: Ehsan
citation.text: "Ehsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group meets Argivian soldiers and learns crucial information about the upcoming battle.
timeline.quote: During the meeting with the Argivian soldiers, Ehsan was mostly silent

citation.work: Ehsan
citation.text: "Ehsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the trenches near Tomakul in 44 AR, Karrak, Farid and Aiman discuss deserting before an offensive after new orders signal an attack.
timeline.quote: Karrak, Farid, and Aiman discussed deserting before the offensive

citation.work: Karrak
citation.text: "Karrak", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karrak joins Farid, Aiman and Ehsan on a covert mission through the trenches; Farid negotiates with Sergeant Usman and a trade with the Argivians takes place.
timeline.quote: Karrak joined Farid, Aiman, and Ehsan in a covert mission through the trenches

citation.work: Karrak
citation.text: "Karrak", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the battlefield and reaches the abandoned Argivian trench.
timeline.quote: Upon reaching the abandoned Argivian trench

citation.work: Karrak
citation.text: "Karrak", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Laria meets Farid and his team covertly and trades warnings of the coming battle.
timeline.quote: She participated in a covert meeting with Farid and his team, facilitating trade between their factions.

citation.work: Laria
citation.text: "Laria", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: The ghost tells Aiman 'Not yet', sparing his life.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 3: Sword One" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2022.
